name: RISA Kouchou no Baai "Tsuiseki"
source:
Miyazaki Risa starts for her new post as a headmaster of the private school, following in the footsteps of her father died recently. But she is not long before she finds the school has been actually dominated by an assistant principal (player) for years. He had embezzled a large amount of cash contribution and is afraid Risa finds the defalcation. He attempts to rape her until she becomes a sex slave of him to put her off the track.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ028593.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
宫崎里沙追随最近去世的父亲的脚步，开始担任私立学校的校长。但没过多久，她就发现学校多年来一直由副校长（球员）主导。他挪用了大量的现金捐款，担心丽莎发现他的贪污行为。他试图强奸她，直到她成为他的性奴隶，使她偏离轨道。
